taxonomic_event_definitions.TRUE_POSITIVE_EVENT: AI event matches ground truth event with temporal IoU >= 0.50 and matching hazard category.
taxonomic_event_definitions.FALSE_POSITIVE_EVENT: AI event triggered without corresponding ground truth physical hazard.
taxonomic_event_definitions.MISSED_EVENT: Ground truth hazard episode elapsed without AI confirming danger.
taxonomic_event_definitions.PARTIAL_EVENT: AI detected only a small fraction (temporal IoU < 0.30) of the hazard event.
taxonomic_event_definitions.FRAGMENTED_EVENT: Single continuous physical event was split into >= 2 AI event episodes (FAIL-41).
taxonomic_event_definitions.DUPLICATED_EVENT: Multiple overlapping AI event IDs created for the same physical entity pair.
